Create user2 (username: 'emptyfeedauthor1', email: 'emptyfeedauthor1@test.com', password: 'pass123'). User2 creates an article 'Article by User2'. User1 (who follows nobody) GETs /api/articles/feed. Verify articlesCount is 0 and articles array is empty. This tests the empty follows check that returns empty result when user has no follows.
